## Triage: graded p2 · `domain:skills` · `area:devpath` · `bug` · `pm:queue`. Route: the register follows the guard that is enforced

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-22T09:53Z. ⛔ Not a claim.

- **Lane:** the governed register (`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`) and its relay consumer are the governance-enforcement files of `domain:skills` (lane table).
- **Route, the no-regret one:**
  - scope the `claude-tree` row by repo, as the `workflows` row already is, so that objectui's `.claude/**` reads **Tier H**, the tier objectui's own queue guard enforces today;
  - have `ops.mjs`'s `governedReviewRequests` request both approvers for it.
  The register stops promising a landing route that the queue refuses. No gate is loosened.
- **Not taken here:** giving objectui's guard a Tier S arm. That loosens an enforced guard, so it is the maintainer's call. It is put to them in this round's report, and this card does not wait on it.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (card thread) · 2026-10-22T12:58Z · p2, `bug`, `domain:skills`. The governed register's `claude-tree` row reads Tier S for every governed repo, but only objectstack's queue guard has a Tier S arm; objectui's `.claude/**` must read the tier objectui's guard enforces (Tier H), and the relay's governed-review follow-up must then request the approvers for it. Route per triage 6337908442, taken as the seat's mechanism assumption, ⛔ no gate loosened.

(stop on breach; explain in the report)
⛔ Not in scope: objectui's own guard (`scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` in objectui); a Tier S arm for objectui; `.github/CODEOWNERS`; any governed prose file.

Review: the seat's review of record at its own tier; `check-governed-merges.mjs` is a CODEOWNERS enforcement-chain row, so GitHub requests the approvers when the PR is marked ready — the seat reads `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test <your paths>` for the landing route and records it in the ACCEPT.
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: the register in `check-governed-merges.mjs` promises a Tier S landing for objectui `.claude/**` that objectui's `merge_group` guard refuses | objectui's lane file already tells the seat to stop at draft for an approval, the stricter rule, so no PR has landed wrongly (the filing seat followed it on objectui#13320) | every seat that lands an objectui `.claude/**` PR, measured once on objectui#13320 (2026-10-22)
Thread-read: 6337908442
Serial constraints cleared: no open objectstack PR touches `check-governed-merges.mjs`, `fleet-write/ops.mjs` or `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (seat's open-PR file scan, 8 open PRs, 0 hits; re-checked by this thread before the first edit: 10 open PRs, 0 hits, `fleet-write/execute.mjs` included); the lane's other in-flight and queued cards (#25185, #25115, #25191, #25070) touch `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `ensure-pm-labels.sh` and `check-half-states.mjs` only.
